Name: Stardrop Soda
Author: SwordDays
Description:
[size=5]Overview[/size]
If we're running Joja out of town, we might as well get rid of their vending machine too.

This mod adds a short questline that unlocks as you progress through the Community Center. Help Gus bring homemade soda to the saloon and you'll be rewarded with a new vending machine that replaces the Joja Cola in the saloon with something new. The first soda you'll unlock comes with a longer speed buff than Joja Cola, and the second comes with even better buffs and a secret bonus. Try giving it to someone and see what they have to say :)

Before you install, know that this mod makes [b]two big changes.[/b]

First, it replaces the vending machine in the saloon after completing the first quest. Joja Cola will still be available everywhere else, but it'll be gone from the saloon for good unless you uninstall this mod.

Second, it [b]locks growable ancient seeds behind the questline[/b] and makes it a mid-late game item. You'll still be able to dig up the ancient seed artifact and donate it as normal, but you won't get the growable seeds or the crafting recipe. If you want more information on how to unlock the seeds, check out the quest instructions below.

[size=5]Spoilers[/size]
[size=3]Quest Instructions[/size]
[spoiler]Quest 1: Enter the saloon any time before 1800 once you've completed two full Community Center rooms. Gus will send you on a quest to collect a starfruit for him. Deliver it to him, then enter the saloon any time before 1800 after that day to replace the Joja Cola machine with one that sells Starfruit Soda.

Quest 2: Complete Quest 1 and four full Community Center rooms, then enter the museum any time before 1200. Gus will send you on another quest, this time to grow an ancient fruit from seeds provided by Gunther (no need to bring your own). Deliver the fruit to Gus and starting tomorrow you'll be able to buy Stardrop Soda from the saloon.[/spoiler]

[size=3]Soda Information[/size]
[spoiler][b]Starfruit Soda[/b]

Liked by: Alex, Caroline, Clint, Demetrius, Dwarf, Elliott, Emily, Evelyn, George, Gus, Harvey, Jodi, Kent, Krobus, Leah, Leo, Lewis, Linus, Marnie, Maru, Pam, Penny, Pierre, Robin, Sam, Sandy, Sebastian, Shane, Willy, Wizard
Disliked by: Abigail, Haley, Jas, Vincent
Buffs: +1 speed for 2.5 minutes

[b]Stardrop Soda[/b]

Liked by: everyone
Buffs: +1 speed and +1 luck for 5 minutes
Give one to any vanilla townie for an in-game way of finding out what their favorite gifts are[/spoiler]

[size=5]Configuration[/size]
The easiest way to change the settings is with the in-game [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] config menu. Your options are:
[list]
[*][b]Vending Machine Color:[/b] Choose what color you want the new vending machine to be. Choose "New" for a bright blue machine that matches the new soda bottles, or choose "Original" to keep the original color minus Joja's name. This is set to "New" by default.[/*]
[*][b]Soda Price[/b]: Choose how expensive you want the new sodas in the machine to be. The defaults are 500 for the Starfruit Soda and 1000 for the Stardrop Soda.[/*]
[/list][size=5]Compatibility[/size]

[b]Do I need a new save for this?
[/b]I recommend it for immersion purposes, but it's not necessary. Just be warned that the timing of the quests will be off if your current save is far enough along.

[b]Is this compatible with mods that change the saloon's map?
[/b]This mod's map only changes the 6 tiles the vanilla vending machine takes up. As long as your other mod doesn't change the same tiles and as long as it doesn't try to move the vanilla vending machine, it should be fine, but I make no promises.

Confirmed compatibility with:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12442]Less Ugly Interiors[/url]﻿[/*]
[/list][b]Is this compatible with recolors?[/b]
Yes, as long as you're fine with the colors not matching. This mod uses its own tilesheet for the new vending machine so whatever changes your other mods make to the vanilla tilesheets won't apply.

Confirmed compatibility with:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral[/url]﻿[/*]
[/list][size=5]Installation[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods OR use the Mod Manager Download button.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Enjoy![/*]
[/list]
